The sharpened bones jabbed into it make it a brutal weapon.|Allies|AoC}} ==Locations and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 12 |durability = 14 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Spiked Boko Club}} Spiked Boko Clubs are common [[Weapon]]s throughout [[Hyrule]]. Sharpened bones have been added to them to increase their damage. These Clubs belong to the [[Bokoblin Gear]] equipment archetype, which includes all Weapons created by [[Bokoblin]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} [[Link]] may first see one in a [[Monster Stronghold]] near the [[Great Plateau Tower]], where it is being wielded by a [[Blue Bokoblin]]. After that, Link will find them in various Bokoblin [[Monster Stronghold]]s on his adventure, particularly in the [[Faron Grasslands]] and [[East Necluda]]. They can also appear in [[Treasure Chest]]s that spawn after the {{BotW}} Series Bokoblin [[amiibo]] has been scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] [[Rune]]. Due to their wooden composition, Spiked Boko Clubs will burn if exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. Enemy Bokoblins will often ignite them at a [[Campfire]] before attacking to deal additional Fire damage. They also do not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]] like metallic Weapons do, and they will float on [[Water (Terrain)|Water]] if dropped.
